description: This map depicts an area in Täby, Sweden, with land cover and land use features overlaid on false-colour infrared satellite imagery. The underlying imagery shows dense vegetation in bright red, urban and impervious surfaces in grey/blue tones, and a water body (river or lake) in dark blue/black. A prominent turquoise polygon outlines a linear feature extending approximately north-south across the map, labelled with the code "1220". This label, referencing the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Land Cover / Land Use (LCLU) nomenclature, corresponds to "1.2.2 Railways and associated land". The railway feature is shown bordering a river in the upper part of the map and traversing through an area with mixed urban and vegetated land uses. Additional thinner green lines delineate the boundaries of other land cover/use polygons throughout the depicted landscape. No scale bar, compass, or explicit legend is visible within the image.
